tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild anemia with slightly decreased hemoglobin and hematocrit, while red cell indices are within normal limits, suggesting normocytic, normochromic anemia. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is markedly elevated, indicating increased variability in platelet size, which may reflect platelet activation or production changes. Further clinical correlation and investigation into the cause of anemia and platelet changes are recommended.
